newsitem.title: USA: Patterson Energy adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Patterson Energy adopts rights plan.

text.p: Patterson Energy Inc on Friday said it adopted a shareholder rights plan that would be triggered if an individual or group acquired 15 percent or more of the company's outstanding common stock.
Patterson said the plan was intended to deter a hostile takeover bid and prevent any individual or group from gaining control of the company without offering a fair price to the stockholders.
The company said the plan was not adopted in response to any takeover attempt.
Under the plan, the right to buy one preferred stock will be created and issued for each share of the company's common stock held as of the close of business on January 17.
Each right will entitle stockholders to buy 1/100th of a share of Series A participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $166, it said.
